briefdescription.para: This function initializes the specified ChaCha20-Poly1305 context.

detaileddescription.para: It must be the first API called before using the context. It must be followed by a call to mbedtls_chachapoly_setkey() before any operation can be done, and to mbedtls_chachapoly_free() once all operations with that context have been finished.
In order to encrypt or decrypt full messages at once, for each message you should make a single call to mbedtls_chachapoly_crypt_and_tag() or mbedtls_chachapoly_auth_decrypt().

In order to encrypt messages piecewise, for each message you should make a call to mbedtls_chachapoly_starts(), then 0 or more calls to mbedtls_chachapoly_update_aad(), then 0 or more calls to mbedtls_chachapoly_update(), then one call to mbedtls_chachapoly_finish().

Decryption with the piecewise API is discouraged! Always use mbedtls_chachapoly_auth_decrypt() when possible! If however this is not possible because the data is too large to fit in memory, you need to:

listitem.para: call mbedtls_chachapoly_starts() and (if needed) mbedtls_chachapoly_update_aad() as above,
call mbedtls_chachapoly_update() multiple times and ensure its output (the plaintext) is NOT used in any other way than placing it in temporary storage at this point,
call mbedtls_chachapoly_finish() to compute the authentication tag and compared it in constant time to the tag received with the ciphertext.

detaileddescription.para: If the tags are not equal, you must immediately discard all previous outputs of mbedtls_chachapoly_update(), otherwise you can now safely use the plaintext.

parameterdescription.para: The ChachaPoly context to initialize. Must not be NULL.

briefdescription.para: This function starts a ChaCha20-Poly1305 encryption or decryption operation.

simplesect.para: You must never use the same nonce twice with the same key. This would void any confidentiality and authenticity guarantees for the messages encrypted with the same nonce and key.
If the context is being used for AAD only (no data to encrypt or decrypt) then mode can be set to any value.

briefdescription.para: This function feeds additional data to be authenticated into an ongoing ChaCha20-Poly1305 operation.

detaileddescription.para: The Additional Authenticated Data (AAD), also called Associated Data (AD) is only authenticated but not encrypted nor included in the encrypted output. It is usually transmitted separately from the ciphertext or computed locally by each party.

This function is called before data is encrypted/decrypted. I.e. call this function to process the AAD before calling mbedtls_chachapoly_update(). You may call this function multiple times to process an arbitrary amount of AAD. It is permitted to call this function 0 times, if no AAD is used.
This function cannot be called any more if data has been processed by mbedtls_chachapoly_update(), or if the context has been finished.

simplesect.para: Decryption with the piecewise API is discouraged, see the warning on mbedtls_chachapoly_init().

parameterdescription.para: The ChaCha20-Poly1305 context. This must be initialized and bound to a key.
The length in Bytes of the AAD. The length has no restrictions.
Buffer containing the AAD. This pointer can be NULL if aad_len == 0.

simplesect.para: 0 on success.
MBEDTLS_ERR_POLY1305_BAD_INPUT_DATA if ctx or aad are NULL.
MBEDTLS_ERR_CHACHAPOLY_BAD_STATE if the operations has not been started or has been finished, or if the AAD has been finished.

briefdescription.para: This file contains the AEAD-ChaCha20-Poly1305 definitions and functions.

detaileddescription.para: ChaCha20-Poly1305 is an algorithm for Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data (AEAD) that can be used to encrypt and authenticate data. It is based on ChaCha20 and Poly1305 by Daniel Bernstein and was standardized in RFC 7539.
